q: A bag contains 3 red balls, 5 blue balls, and 2 green balls. What is the probability of randomly selecting a red ball?
A fair six-sided die is rolled. What is the probability of rolling a number greater than 4?
A fair coin is tossed twice. What is the probability of getting exactly one head?
A letter is chosen at random from the word APPLE. What is the probability that it is a vowel?
A whole number is randomly selected from 1 to 15 inclusive. What is the probability that the number is a multiple of 4?
What is the probability of an impossible event?
What is the probability of a sure event?
If the probability of an event A is \( 0.3 \), what is the probability of not A?
A box contains 4 white marbles and 6 black marbles. What is the probability of randomly selecting a white marble?
A card is drawn at random from a standard deck of 52 cards. What is the probability that it is a heart?
If \( P(E) = \frac{7}{12} \), what is \( P(\text{not } E) \)?
Which of the following values cannot represent the probability of an event?
For any event A, what is the value of \( P(A) + P(\text{not } A) \)?
A number is randomly selected from 1 to 10 inclusive. What is the probability that the number is prime?
A bag contains 8 red balls and 12 blue balls. What is the probability of not selecting a red ball?
Events A and B are independent. If \( P(A) = 0.4 \) and \( P(B) = 0.5 \), what is \( P(A \text{ and } B) \)?
A fair coin is tossed and a fair die is rolled. What is the probability of getting a head and a 6?
Two fair coins are tossed. What is the probability of getting two tails?
Bag 1 contains 2 red and 3 blue balls. Bag 2 contains 4 red and 1 blue ball. One ball is drawn from each bag. What is the probability that both are red?
Events A and B are independent. If \( P(A) = \frac{1}{3} \) and \( P(B) = \frac{1}{4} \), what is \( P(A \text{ and } B) \)?
Spinner 1 has numbers 1 to 4. Spinner 2 has numbers 1 to 6. Both are spun. What is the probability that both show an even number?
Events A and B are independent. If \( P(A) = 0.6 \) and \( P(B) = 0.2 \), what is \( P(\text{not } A \text{ and } B) \)?
A bag contains 5 red and 5 blue balls. Two balls are drawn without replacement. What is the probability that both are red?
A box contains 3 green and 7 yellow marbles. Two marbles are drawn without replacement. What is the probability that the first is green and the second is yellow?
A box contains 10 cards numbered 1 to 10. Two cards are drawn without replacement. What is the probability that both are odd numbers?
A bag contains 4 white and 6 black balls. Two balls are drawn without replacement. What is the probability that both are white?
A group has 3 boys and 5 girls. Two students are selected at random without replacement. What is the probability that both are girls?
A box contains 2 red, 3 blue, and 5 green marbles. Two marbles are drawn without replacement. What is the probability that the first is red and the second is blue?
Events A and B are mutually exclusive. If \( P(A) = 0.3 \) and \( P(B) = 0.4 \), what is \( P(A \text{ or } B) \)?
If \( P(A) = 0.5 \), \( P(B) = 0.6 \), and \( P(A \text{ and } B) = 0.2 \), what is \( P(A \text{ or } B) \)?
A fair die is rolled. What is the probability of getting an even number or a number greater than 4?
A card is drawn from a standard deck of 52 cards. What is the probability that it is a King or a Queen?
If \( P(A) = 0.4 \), \( P(B) = 0.5 \), and \( P(A \text{ or } B) = 0.7 \), what is \( P(A \text{ and } B) \)?
A number is randomly selected from 1 to 20 inclusive. What is the probability that it is a multiple of 2 or a multiple of 5?
A bag contains 3 red, 4 blue, and 3 green balls. What is the probability of selecting a red or a green ball?
A fair coin is tossed 200 times. What is the expected frequency of getting heads?
A fair die is rolled 60 times. What is the expected frequency of rolling a 3?
The probability of rain on any given day is 0.3. In a period of 50 days, how many rainy days are expected?
A spinner is equally likely to land on any number from 1 to 8. If it is spun 160 times, what is the expected frequency of landing on a prime number?
A bag contains 2 red and 3 blue balls. A ball is drawn, replaced, and this is repeated 100 times. What is the expected frequency of drawing a red ball?
The probability of an item being defective is 0.05. In a batch of 1000 items, how many defective items are expected?
Two fair dice are thrown 360 times. What is the expected frequency of the sum being 7?
A biased coin has a probability of 0.6 for landing on heads. If it is tossed 500 times, what is the expected frequency of landing on tails?
A wheel has 10 equal sectors, 3 of which are red. If the wheel is spun 200 times, what is the expected frequency of landing on red?
The probability of winning a game is 0.25. If the game is played 80 times, what is the expected number of wins?
